finalText:
**Redis outage cascaded into a full crash.**

`redis connection lost: ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379` at `02:14:07`. Cache fell back to direct store reads, queue depth climbed from 52 to 568+ over 17 minutes. 12 reconnect attempts all failed, last at `02:31:26`.

`worker-2` hit `JavaScript heap out of memory` at `02:31:44`, then `supervisor` killed the whole process group at `02:31:52`.

Next: check why Redis at `10.0.0.12:6379` was unreachable that whole window.
